description.fr-FR: Le questionnaire que Fénelon composa pour l’instruction de Louis de France, duc de Bourgogne, petit-fils de Louis XIV, afin qu’il examine devant Dieu l’exercice de sa charge : devoirs envers Dieu, la religion, la justice, les finances, la guerre, la paix, les ministres et les peuples.
description.en-US: The questionnaire Fénelon composed for the instruction of Louis of France, Duke of Burgundy, grandson of Louis XIV, so that he might examine before God the exercise of his office: duties towards God, religion, justice, finances, war, peace, ministers and peoples.
description.pt-BR: O questionário que Fénelon compôs para a instrução de Luís da França, duque de Borgonha, neto de Luís XIV, a fim de que examinasse diante de Deus o exercício de seu cargo: deveres para com Deus, a religião, a justiça, as finanças, a guerra, a paz, os ministros e os povos.

fr-FR.editor: J.-E.-A. Gosselin (éd. Saint-Sulpice), Paris: Leroux et Jouby / Gaume

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Fénelon, Paris, Leroux et Jouby, 1851 (éd. Gosselin, Saint-Sulpice), tome 7, p. 1–; archive.org OCR (ABBYY).
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary; period spelling kept. Residual OCR errors remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Fénelon died in 1715; the 1851 edition is public domain.
